playback: Play each row left to right and loop. Column 0=left-foot stride, 1=passing A, 2=right-foot stride, 3=passing B. Right-facing frames are a horizontal flip of left. Feet share one baseline with no walk bob.
alignment: Foot-midpoint centered on x=128. All frames share one baseline (no bob).

fix_notes.body: 2.2-head Q with moderate shoulder/limb volume (between the slim and barrel-belly versions). Mid-torso is a straight or slightly tucked cylinder — no protruding belly. Brokers and the shopkeeper use a stronger waist flatten.
fix_notes.left: Reshaped hem-locked side cycle, opposite arm swing (left foot forward ⇒ right/far arm forward; pass frames hang), packed at the same body height as front/back, abdomen flattened on the side silhouette.
fix_notes.down: Reshaped v2.8 foot-swap down frames with the same no-belly profile; light opposite arm shift on stride frames when the shell is clean.
fix_notes.up: Reshaped v2.8 foot-swap up frames, with the same light front/back arm shift when clean.
